role: The command block: a tile-entity block whose GUI edits a command that redstone or its own updateTick triggers; the block itself is unbreakable in survival and drops nothing.
scope_reason: Not obtainable in survival and commands are not part of the game (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md).

members.name: createNewTileEntity
members.note: tileentity.c:236 maps 137 to TE_COMMAND_BLOCK; the NBT carries SuccessCount and TrackOutput defaults (tileentity.c:765).

members.name: func_149738_a
members.note: The tick-rate override; nothing schedules it.

members.name: onBlockActivated
members.note: Opens the command-editing GUI; no GUI exists (survival.c:4946 answers the client half as true only).

members.name: hasComparatorInputOverride
members.note: The SuccessCount comparator output; redstone off.

members.name: onBlockPlacedBy
members.note: The CommandBlockLogic name transfer; no naming is ported.

missing: The command execution machine (CommandBlockLogic.func_145755_a: parse, run, SuccessCount) has no native counterpart; commands are not used in this game.
BlockCommandBlock.onBlockActivated's GUI and onBlockPlacedBy's name transfer are not ported.
The redstone trigger (onNeighborBlockChange, updateTick, func_149738_a) is not ported: world.conf redstone = off.
notes: Scope is in_scope because the block, its registry entry and its tile entity all exist and are serialized; the dead parts are named above. The client-side activation answer (survival.c:4946) matches vanilla's isRemote branch.
